content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to connect a [product_name] module to a [product_name] VSD-drive ([product_name]). My goal is to manage the drive using the HMI panel already linked to the [product_name] module. Whenever I set the control module to Ethernet instead of Profinet, everything stops working. My network does not use a DHCP server—only static IP mapping. Is it possible to achieve this setup? I simply wish to send speed commands and a few control bits from the [product_name] to operate the VSD.
I also want to know the answer to this question.
Please post in English. Here is a translation ...
The [product_name] module can exchange data with the [version_no] controllers, which operate via Profinet.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties establishing connectivity between a [product_name] module and a [product_name] VSD-drive over Ethernet, particularly in networks utilizing static IP mapping instead of DHCP. There is ongoing uncertainty regarding compatibility between network modes and direct device control capabilities, which is hindering their automation progress.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping to reliably link the [product_name] module to the [product_name] VSD-drive using Ethernet and static IP configuration, allowing the transmission of control commands such as speed and control bits from the [product_name] to the VSD.
